threads.body: [Javaagent] Nodes stashed while the root context is current have no virtual-field value because `ConstructorAdvice` intentionally skips `Context.root()`. In that case, closing the prior scope here restores the context of the message that triggered the unstash, so the root-context message is still interpreted under the wrong parent. Make root current when no context was stored; a root-context stash case should cover this path.

replies.body: Good catch, fixed: when a node has no stored context, root is made current so the unstashed message no longer runs in the context of the message that triggered the unstash. The stash test now also stashes a message sent outside any span and checks it ends up in its own trace.

Addressed in a later commit: `UnstashScope.switchTo` now makes `Context.root()` current when the stashed node has no stored context. The typed `stashAndUnstash` test stashes a message sent in the root context and asserts its span has no parent.

threads.body: [Testing] This does not force the sends through `UnstartedCell`: the guardian may process `Supervise` and replace the cell before these subsequent tells. The normal dispatcher instrumentation then produces the same asserted trace, so this test can pass even if the new `PekkoUnstartedCellInstrumentation` is absent. Please block actor activation until both messages have been queued, then release it, so this race path is exercised deterministically.

replies.body: Agreed, fixed: the test now runs on a separate actor system whose internal dispatcher (which the guardians use) has a single thread. The top level actor is created and messaged from an actor on that same dispatcher, so the guardian cannot process `Supervise` until those sends are done and they are guaranteed to go through `UnstartedCell`. Verified the test fails without the `UnstartedCell` instrumentation.

Addressed in a later commit: the `UnstartedCell` path is now covered by `tellBeforeStarted`. The spawner runs on a single-threaded internal dispatcher shared with the guardian, so the greeter's `Supervise` can't be processed until the spawner's message completes, and all sends go through `UnstartedCell`. With `PekkoUnstartedCellInstrumentation` removed, the test fails for both counts.

threads.body: Could use `Context.current()`. Since advice sets `inline = false` it won't be inlined into the target class so using `Context.current()` won't cause issues even if the instrumented class has pre java 8 bytecode. For 3.0 version we'll switch to non-inlined advice, for 2.x versions that used inlined advice we used to erase `inline = false` but since the next release is going to be 3.0 that is not going to happen any more.

replies.body: Thanks, switched to `Context.current()` in the advice added by this PR.

threads.body: [Testing] `tellBeforeStarted` queues both messages under `parent`, whose attached context cannot be overwritten by `PropagatedContext.setContext()`. Those assertions therefore do not cover this root-context isolation. A message queued under `Context.root()` has no attached context and could inherit the startup thread's `create` context if this isolation regressed. Extend the deterministic startup fixture to queue work explicitly under `Context.root()` and assert that it produces a separate trace with no parent.

replies.body: Good point, added: the spawner now also sends a greeting from a new thread (so it has no context at all) before the greeter starts, and the test checks that it ends up in its own trace rather than in the `create` trace that the guardian starts the greeter in. Verified it fails when `ReplaceWithAdvice` does not make root current. Sending under `Context.root().makeCurrent()` from the test code did not exercise this path (the test passed without the isolation), so a plain thread is used instead.

threads.body: [Testing] The typed stash test asserts context only inside successfully unstashed handlers. It does not check that this cleanup restores the triggering message's context before application code continues, or when an unstashed handler throws. Please add installed-agent cases that emit a span immediately after `unstashAll` returns and after catching an unstashed-handler exception, and assert that both use the triggering `unlock` context rather than the last stashed context.

replies.body: Added `unstashRestoresContext` in 0e2de65804. A new `TypedUnstasher` actor stashes one message sent under a `parent` span. On `Unlock` it emits a span right after `unstashAll` returns, or, in the failing variant where the unstashed handler throws, after catching that exception. The test asserts that the span is a child of the `unlock` span, not of the stashed message's `parent`.
